metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2024 · Kaos
metas.description: As discord reigns on Mount Olympus and almighty Zeus spirals into paranoia, three mortals are destined to reshape the future of humankind.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2024 · My Lady Jane
metas.description: Lady Jane Grey and her husband Guildford live during the reign of Edward, son of Henry VIII. She unexpectedly finds herself crowned queen overnight and becomes the target of criminals who want her throne and her head.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2022 · The Lazarus Project
metas.description: A man wakes up to find himself reliving the same events over and over again. Confused, he is introduced to the Lazarus Project, a top-secret organization that uses its ability to rewind time to save the world from extinction.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2026 · Small Prophets
metas.description: Eccentric Michael Sleep, whose darling partner, Clea, disappeared seven years ago, sets out to create Homunculi - magical prophesying spirits that can predict the future.
